components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main continuation or confirm action in dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--accent); color: var(--cell-highlight-text); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 900 0.875rem var(--font-body); transition: transform 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px var(--glow-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-0.125rem); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cell-highlight-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Circular utility control for hint, reroll, and theme.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Use hint"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M9 18h6"/><path d="M10 22h4"/><path d="M8.5 14.5c-1.5-1.1-2.5-2.9-2.5-4.8A6 6 0 0 1 18 9.7c0 1.9-.9 3.7-2.5 4.8-.6.4-.9 1-.9 1.7H9.4c0-.7-.3-1.3-.9-1.7Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); background: var(--panel-muted); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--panel-border) 45%, transparent); transition: transform 200ms ease-out, background 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-button:hover { transform: translateY(-0.125rem); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 50%, transparent); background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cell-highlight-ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tool Button Active
components.description: Select or Erase mode button when active.
components.css: .ds-tool-active { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; width: 12rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 1.25rem; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--text-primary); padding: 0.75rem; text-align: left; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 28%, transparent), 0 12px 22px var(--shadow-soft); transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-active:hover { transform: translateY(-0.125rem); } .ds-tool-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cell-highlight-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tool-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--accent); color: var(--cell-highlight-text); } .ds-tool-copy { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; text-align: right; } .ds-tool-copy strong { font: 700 0.875rem var(--font-body); } .ds-tool-copy small { font: 900 0.7rem var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Puzzle Cell
components.css: .ds-cell { aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 4rem; border: 1px solid var(--cell-border); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--cell-bg); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--cell-border) 40%, transparent), 0 9px 18px var(--shadow-soft); transition: transform 200ms ease-out, background 200ms ease-out, border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-cell span { font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Avenir Next', var(--font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cell:hover { transform: translateY(-0.25rem); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 60%, transparent); background: var(--cell-hover); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cell-highlight-ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-cell:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--cell-border) 34%, transparent); }

components.name: Selected Puzzle Cell
components.description: Cell after the player marks it as selected.
components.css: .ds-cell-selected { aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 4rem; border: 1px solid var(--cell-highlight-border); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--cell-highlight); color: var(--cell-highlight-text); box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent-strong) 42%, transparent), 0 14px 26px var(--shadow-board); animation: ds-good-pop 180ms ease-out; } .ds-cell-selected span { font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Avenir Next', var(--font-display); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @keyframes ds-good-pop { 0% { transform: scale(0.92); } 60% { transform: scale(1.06); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Target Badge
components.css: .ds-target { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 4rem; border: 1px solid var(--target-border); border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--target-bg); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--target-border) 34%, transparent), 0 8px 18px var(--shadow-soft); font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Avenir Next', var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-target strong { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-target small { position: absolute; right: 0.25rem; top: 0.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-soft); padding: 0 0.25rem; color: var(--accent-strong); font: 900 0.6rem var(--font-body); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact board status, teaching, or modifier marker.
components.html: Correct 8
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel-muted); color: var(--text-secondary); padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--panel-border) 35%, transparent); font: 900 0.75rem var(--font-body); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(100%, 24rem); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); border-radius: 2rem; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent-soft) 70%, transparent), transparent 16rem), var(--panel-bg); color: var(--text-primary); padding: 1.5rem; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px var(--shadow-board); } .ds-dialog-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--success) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--success) 18%, transparent); color: var(--success); font: 900 1.5rem var(--font-body); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 1rem 0 0; font: 900 1.875rem var(--font-body); } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0.5rem auto 0; max-width: 28ch; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 0.875rem/1.45 var(--font-body); }

narrative.overview:
Cross Multiply should feel like a small, well-made puzzle table that fits in a quick break. The surface is warm, tactile, and compact: the board is the object, and every surrounding system exists to help a player make the next confident mark.

The design uses softly tinted cyan-green neutrals, pill-sized status objects, chunky numeric cells, and restrained celebratory color. It is not a classroom worksheet and it is not a casino reward machine. It should reward quiet mastery: useful feedback, short copy, forgiving tap targets, and enough playfulness to make multiplication feel like puzzle material.
keyCharacteristics: Board-first hierarchy, with progression systems visually secondary.
Tactile cells that depress, lift, lock, hide, and resolve through state.
OKLCH colors tuned for light and dark modes, never pure black or pure white as the visible default.
Dense but friendly controls for quick mobile sessions.
State copy that should be short, plain, and encouraging.

rules.name: The Board Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color belongs first to the board and live puzzle state. Progression, missions, and chapter admin must stay softer than the cells.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Overlay Rule
rules.body: Modal overlays must stay tinted toward the app background. Use the existing `oklch(15% 0.02 230 / 0.5)` approach or a warmer equivalent, never `#000` or plain `black`.

rules.name: The Reward Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Lemon, berry, sky, success, and danger are state colors. They must not become broad decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Objects Rule
rules.body: Board values, targets, levels, and progress counts use the `game-number` treatment with tabular figures. Do not set puzzle numbers in the normal body stack.

rules.name: The Label Density Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels are allowed because the interface is compact, but they must stay short. If a label wraps awkwardly, rewrite it before shrinking it.

rules.name: The Pressable Depth Rule
rules.body: If a control can be tapped repeatedly, it may use an inset bottom shadow. If it is just information, prefer tonal contrast and border over lift.

rules.name: The Dialogs Are Moments Rule
rules.body: Large ambient shadows are reserved for dialogs and the board shell. Repeated side-panel cards should not compete with the board.

dos: Do keep the board, targets, current mode, hearts, and next useful action visually dominant.
Do use OKLCH tokens from `src/index.css` and Tailwind theme bindings rather than ad hoc hex colors.
Do treat Select, Erase, Fog, Blind, Cipher, No Echo, and Hold as teachable state language. Explain each at the point it first matters.
Do use `game-number` for board values, target products, level numbers, and result metrics.
Do preserve light and dark mode parity when changing any token or component state.
Do make touch targets at least 44px high for repeated mobile actions.
Do use short, warm result copy. The player should feel sharper, not scolded.
donts: Don't create school worksheet energy with sterile grids, plain arithmetic labels, or teacherly instruction blocks.
Don't add casino or mobile-game grind patterns: no noisy reward loops, manipulative streak chrome, or oversized currency systems.
Don't drift into sterile math-tool minimalism. The cells should feel tactile, not like a spreadsheet.
Don't use neon arcade styling, high-chroma blacklight palettes, or glow as the main identity.
Don't use corporate SaaS conventions such as hero-metric layouts, generic glass cards, or dashboard-first hierarchy.
Don't bury the puzzle under side-panel systems. Missions, modifiers, chapter progress, and unlocks are secondary to the active board.
Don't use `border-left` or `border-right` greater than 1px as a colored stripe.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, nested cards, or pure black and white defaults.
